known_limitations: MVP isolation is application-level and is not an operating-system sandbox
ControlPlane and LocalRunner are separate code responsibilities but still run in one process with the same host identity
SQLite leases coordinate only local workers and do not provide remote authentication or distributed queue semantics
Cancellation is cooperative and cannot terminate an adapter process tree already in progress
Jobs interrupted during an effectful phase require operator-reviewed recovery; automatic rollback is not implemented
The symlink escape test could not create a Windows symlink without elevated privilege; link and reparse-point refusal code remains active
Only UTF-8 text mutation is supported; binary files are metadata-only
Validation adapters support only explicitly allowlisted local argv
Dependency installation is disabled by default
Deletion, merge, force-push, deployment, and credential operations are prohibited
Remote Git push and localhost Streamable HTTP were not exercised end to end in this checkpoint
No public MCP endpoint, remote authentication, or ChatGPT Web connection has been implemented or tested
